translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「...More than that, if people thought we left Lady Magic alone

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: The entire Zeth army, plus the volunteers rallied by Magic,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: The demon army was given no chance to recover,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: meeting one of those two fates.
